rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for liquid fruit juice and a juice drink ordered or served as a beverage.

example.english: I want a glass of juice.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 bui1 gwo2 zap1

rows.note: Use this for the Scottish sense where “juice” means a carbonated soft drink rather than fruit juice.

example.english: I like having juice with fries.
example.jyutping: sik6 syu4 tiu4 ngo5 zung1 ji3 jam2 hei3 seoi2
